pages: Day 136: They bar the gates now. Word runs ahead of us on the roads, carried by the ones who got away, and He says the ones who got away are the ones to fear most, because they carry it with them in their blood. So we follow the roads.

I saw the staff up close tonight. It is bone, old and new together, and it is warm. When He set it down beside the fire, the crows came down off the roofs and sat in a ring around it and did not make a sound. I had never seen a crow be quiet.

I am hiding these pages. One in every place we leave behind, under what is left of a floor, in a well that has gone dry, between the stones of a hearth. If He finds this book, He will burn it. If you find a page, keep going. The rest is on the road ahead.
